protocol.k_definition: unique target prompts with at least one action label; dense safety prompts are included in k
protocol.deployment_safety: a fixed 200-prompt reserve is drawn from the raw deployment distribution; each k uses a growing prefix and the remaining raw prompts are the fixed final test
protocol.fit_pool_reserve: fit rows are nested prefixes after a fixed 200-row pool offset; this preserves existing Exp43 caches, while the pool reserve is not used as deployment safety
protocol.generated_pool_safety_role: diagnostic only because its gate behavior is distribution-shifted, especially on UniGen
protocol.k400_reanchored: yes; Exp43 k400 uses the fixed 200-prompt future-safety reserve, whereas Exp42 only reserved 50
